title: Quick Japanese Curry Rice (Kare Raisu)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, beef chuck, or pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 medium carrots, cut into rolling wedges (rangiri)
1 tbsp grated ginger & 2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 package (approx. 4.5 oz) S&B Golden Curry or Vermont Curry roux blocks
1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey or grated apple, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Steamed short-grain Japanese rice & fukujinzuke (pickled radish)
instructions: Sear the chicken, beef, or pork pieces in 1 tbsp neutral oil in a Dutch oven until browned. Add sliced onions and caramelize for 6–8 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, carrots, and potatoes; stir for 2 minutes, then pour in the stock. Bring to a boil, skim foam, cover, and simmer 15–20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Turn off the heat, break in the Japanese curry roux blocks, and stir until completely dissolved.
Turn heat back to low, stir in soy sauce, honey/grated apple, and Worcestershire sauce, and simmer 5 minutes until thick and glossy. Serve over steamed rice.
